title: Fix lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h include resolution module-wide
description: Found while verifying bd 6mij.2.2. Five TUs include <lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h> but no CMake include dir maps the lichen/ prefix to subsys/lichen, so all fail: 'fatal error: lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h: No such file or directory'. Affected: subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c, subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c, subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c, subsys/lichen/coap/coap_keys.c, apps/gateway/src/main.c. Regression from file-split refactor 4597da630d: the header lives at subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h; only the unqualified style (#include "ipv6_addr.h", used by apps/puck and link sources via l2 zephyr_include_directories(.)) resolves. Fix options: (A) one line in lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt: zephyr_include_directories(CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR/../subsys) so the qualified spelling resolves module-wide, or (B) migrate the 5 includes to the unqualified style. tests/coap_keys (CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE=y, both native_sim CI and local qemu_x86) cannot compile until this lands; bd 6mij.2.2 local verification used a throwaway include-dir shim via uncommitted EXTRA_CFLAGS. Local validation: west build -b qemu_x86 tests/coap_keys with ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=lichen module; run with CONFIG_NET_QEMU_SLIP=n CONFIG_NET_SLIP_TAP=n to suppress the unix-socket serial backend.
